events.name: Halloween Spooktacular concert
events.summary: An hour-long Halloween concert (7 to 8 pm) at Cannon Beach Community Church.

events.name: Seaside Halloween Happenin's
events.summary: Free downtown Halloween weekend with a witches and warlocks paddle, kid carnival, pet parade, trunk-or-treat and a giant pumpkin drop; check final times.

events.name: Singing in the Rain
events.summary: Singing in the Rain on the Liberty Theatre's November calendar (Tuesday, Nov. 3); see the listing for showtime.

events.name: Seaside Fall Whiskey & Wine Walk
events.summary: Downtown tasting strolls: whiskey with appetizers Friday 4 to 8 pm, Oregon wine Saturday 3 to 6:30 pm; $20 a walk or $35 for both, 21+.

events.name: Stormy Weather Arts Festival
events.summary: The 39th annual festival fills galleries across town with artist demos and receptions, plus a Nov. 7 spotlight concert at the Coaster Theatre.

events.name: North Coast Symphonic Band: The Art of Dance
events.summary: Sunday 2 pm concert at the Liberty Theatre.

events.name: DREAMPUNK
events.summary: Themed evening performance show at the Liberty Theatre, 7 pm.

events.name: The Wizard of Oz
events.summary: The Coaster Theatre's holiday-season production runs weekends, opening Nov. 20 at 7:30 pm.

events.name: Battle to the Pacific trail runs
events.summary: Bivouac Racing's 20K, 15K and 5K trail races plus a 12-mile ruck challenge, starting around 9 am at Coffenbury Lake.

events.name: The Amazing Bubble Man
events.summary: Sunday 2 pm family bubble show at the Liberty Theatre.

events.name: King tides
events.summary: The first king tide window of the season; NOAA predictions put the biggest tides around Nov. 24 to 26, and the King Tides Project asks for photos.

events.name: Seaside Turkey Trot
events.summary: Thanksgiving morning 5K run/walk on Broadway; check-in at 8 am, start at 9 am.

events.name: Blind Pilot
events.summary: The Oregon folk band plays two nights at the Liberty Theatre (Nov. 27 and 28); check the ticket page for start times.

events.name: Mimosa Madness Weekend
events.summary: Downtown shops kick off Haystack Holidays with extended hours, sales and festive drinks.

events.name: Cannon Beach in Lights
events.summary: A month of holiday lights around town as part of Haystack Holidays.

events.name: Cannon Beach Lamp Lighting Ceremony
events.summary: Free 4 pm lamp lighting in Sandpiper Square to kick off Haystack Holidays.

events.name: Ilwaco Crab Pot Christmas
events.summary: The port lights its tree built from crab pots, with Santa, at 4 pm; dates are subject to change.
